items.title: File Widerspruch against the hedge-trimming order
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 29 Jun 2026, sent by an authority by ordinary post: counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) a few days after posting under the general administrative-law rule (Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG), i.e. Fri 3 Jul 2026. Counting of the one-month Widerspruch period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on the same-numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Mon 3 Aug 2026, which is a business day so no further shift applies.

items.title: Cut the hedge back to the property boundary
items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: This deadline is conditional: it only starts once the order becomes 'bestandskräftig' (final/unappealable). Assuming no Widerspruch is filed, the order becomes final the day after the one-month Widerspruch period expires, i.e. after Mon 3 Aug 2026. Three weeks are then counted from the day after that (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) to Mon 24 Aug 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB), a business day, so no shift is needed. If a Widerspruch is filed in time, Bestandskraft (and this three-week period) is suspended until the Widerspruch procedure concludes, so the real deadline could be much later or not yet running at all.

warnings: The three-week compliance deadline only starts once the order is final (bestandskräftig); if a Widerspruch is filed by 2026-08-03, this deadline does not run as computed and the real date will depend on how the objection is resolved.
The order uses the softer phrase 'Wir bitten um Erledigung' (we ask you to comply) rather than a fixed enforced deadline, so treat 2026-08-24 as the earliest plausible date rather than a certain one.
